column1: #This mapping was created following and expanding upon the SSSOM guidance: https://mapping-commons.github.io/sssom/spec/

column16: DwC expects only the sequence for the forward primer (narrower), while MIxS expects both the forward and reverse primer (broader)
DwC expects only the sequence for the reverse primer (narrower), while MIxS expects both the forward and reverse primer (broader)

DwC expects only the name of one forward primer (narrower), while MIxS expects multiple primer names (broader). DwC encourages users to create complete rows for each forward primer when multiple primers are used.

DwC expects only the name of one reverse primer (narrower), while MIxS expects multiple primer names (broader). DwC encourages users to create complete rows for each forward primer when multiple primers are used.
